   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      22 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.06.2026 - 18.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _BGS Jason_, 18.09.2026, 1/5: "This app used to be functional. Whenever the major UI update rolled out, it’s been riddled with bugs. Whatever you guys did made this app borderline unusable. I assume the technology was offshored and that’s why it turned into what it is now"
            2. _Notcool49_, 17.09.2026, 1/5: "Used to be great until they updated the app. Now it’s horrible and just freezes everything and won’t unblock anything. I guess it’s good cause now I can’t look at anything. Never make the mistake of updating!"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13.09.2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
